prompts.SuperHero:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE final square transparent PNG role icon for a Nebula on the Ship / Among Us addon. Primary request: redraw a coherent game-native icon set. Style: authentic Among Us 2D cartoon visual language: rounded bean astronaut with stubby two legs, visible little backpack, one large glossy cyan glass visor, NO human eyes or mouth or human anatomy, bold very dark ink outlines, very simple broad cel-shaded color areas with one shadow plane and small visor highlight, playful clean silhouette readable at 48 pixels. Crisp hand-inked rounded contours, thin white outer keyline around the entire silhouette to read on a black game UI. Keep it a simple game HUD sprite, not detailed concept art, not realistic, not 3D rendering. Center complete figure and its one distinctive role motif, occupying about 78% of square, at least 10% transparent margin on all sides. Background: actual transparent alpha, no backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow, no opaque card or badge circle. No lettering, no words, no numbers, no logos or watermark. Deliver only the single icon, no sheet, no labels, no extra variants. Maintain the bean-body proportions: large round torso, little backpack, short legs, cyan visor, detachable little mitten hands if needed.
Subject: heroic bright azure-blue crewmate astronaut in an upright confident pose, one mitten fist raised high, sweeping SHORT red cape on its left, small gold diamond lightning emblem on chest, subtle bold golden light rays behind upper shoulders. White eye-mask band framing the cyan visor but no separate eyes. Friendly strong round silhouette. Use blue/red/gold. It must be visibly a normal rounded Among Us astronaut dressed as a superhero, not a humanoid superhero.
